# HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR 164.312 — technical safeguards (US HHS): clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: the covered entity or business associate, and HHS decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).
